title: Taco Meat
description: Versatile lean taco meat cooked in tomato sauce with Mexican spices — the ultimate meal prep base for burritos, tacos, sloppy joes and bowls.

ingredients.text: 3g garlic powder, 3g paprika, 1.5g oregano, 1g chili, 1g cumin

steps: Dice onion; fry in oil on medium heat 2–3 min.
Push onion aside; add beef; spread with spatula. Fry 1 min.
Add all seasonings; toast 15 sec. Add tomato purée; fry 15 sec.
Add tomato sauce with a splash of water; stir; simmer 1–2 min until thick.
Transfer to meal prep container; cool and refrigerate. Lasts 3–4 days.
notes: Use in tacos, burritos, sloppy joes, enchiladas or simply with rice.
